elsewhere.note: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.
“Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,
They each brought tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.
Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion, across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.
He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
